info.title: Kenya Law Akoma Ntoso (AKN) API
info.description: API endpoint connecting AI clients to Kenya statutes, High Court and Appellate judgments, daily cause lists, and official Gazettes.

post.summary: Fetches a raw Akoma Ntoso (AKN) legal document (Act, Judgment, or Legal Notice) or court judgment directory (e.g. /judgments/KESC/2022/) by AKN URI or URL, converting XML/HTML into structured non-truncated Markdown with OSCOLA citations.

akn_url.description: The Akoma Ntoso URI or URL (e.g. '/akn/ke/act/2010/4' or '/judgments/KESC/2022/')

section.description: Optional section number to extract directly (e.g. '12' or 'Section 12')

article.description: Optional article number to extract directly for constitutions (e.g. '1', '2', '22')

200.description: Successful response from Kenya Law AKN service

post.summary: Fetches up to 10 Akoma Ntoso (AKN) legal documents in parallel in a single API call to save context tokens and round-trips.

akn_urls.description: Array of up to 10 Akoma Ntoso URIs or URLs to fetch

200.description: Successful response from Kenya Law AKN service

post.summary: Stateless real-time search across Kenyan Courts (Supreme Court KESC, Court of Appeal KECA, High Court KEHC, Environment & Land Court KEELC, Employment & Labour Relations Court KEELRC, Tribunals). Supports keyword search, citations, or court and year directory queries (e.g. court: 'KESC', year: 2022). Returns AKN URIs, case names, and citations.

query.description: Legal issue or search keywords (e.g. 'unfair termination' or 'Supreme Court 2022'). Optional if court and year are provided.

court.description: Court code or name (e.g. 'KESC', 'KECA', 'KEHC', 'KEELRC', 'Supreme Court', 'Court of Appeal')

court_station.description: Court station filter (e.g. 'Meru' or 'High Court at Meru').

month.description: Decision month number (1-12) when querying a station directory.

year_from.description: Filter judgments delivered on or after this year (e.g. 2020)

200.description: Successful response from Kenya Law AKN service

post.summary: Stateless search across Kenya Acts of Parliament and Legal Notices index (/akn/ke/act/). Returns AKN URIs to active revised statutes.

act_name.description: Name or abbreviation of Act (e.g. 'Employment Act' or 'Data Protection')

200.description: Successful response from Kenya Law AKN service

post.summary: Retrieves daily court cause lists by court station (e.g. 'Milimani Law Courts', 'Mombasa', 'Eldoret') and date. Essential for litigators preparing for court hearings.

court_station.description: Court station name (e.g. 'Milimani Law Courts' or 'High Court at Eldoret')

date.description: Hearing date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to current date)

200.description: Successful response from Kenya Law AKN service

post.summary: Checks whether an official judgment can be retrieved. Subsequent treatment is not checked; this cannot establish good-law status.

case_akn_url.description: The AKN URI or neutral citation of the target case

200.description: Successful response from Kenya Law AKN service

post.summary: Verifies whether a legal citation string or neutral citation exists on Kenya Law, grounding LLM output and preventing hallucinations.

citation_string.description: The citation to verify (e.g. '[2022] KESC 8' or 'Employment Act')

200.description: Successful response from Kenya Law AKN service

post.summary: Stateless real-time search across official Kenya Gazette notices (land title notices, government appointments, probate notices, tribunal decisions).

query.description: Search keyword or gazette notice issue (e.g. 'gazette notice land title' or 'probate')

200.description: Successful response from Kenya Law AKN service
